hero.title: All the corporate governance of your company or group, on a single platform
hero.description: Shareholder register (cap table), shareholder meetings and boards with built-in shareholder communications and e-signature, corporate groups, incentive plans (phantoms and stock options) and secondary market. With AI assistant and ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance.
